text:
I got braces again because I had braces the first time and had fixed retainers, but the teeth not wearing retainers were starting to separate. I wanted braces again to bring my teeth closer together and have more retainers added. The doctor said it would take at least 6 months. Ultimately, I had them removed almost two years later. The doctor checked my teeth many times, but didn't explain anything afterward. I had the rubber bands changed repeatedly for many months without any explanation. Finally, on the day the braces were removed, I found out that my bite had changed due to the braces treatment, making fixed retainers no longer possible... I wasted money on unsatisfactory results and almost two years of travel time, only to find out on the last day that I wasn't getting the desired outcome. If I had known this would happen, I would have opted for clear aligners elsewhere from the start.

Nothing personal here, just that the work process was unacceptable and there was a lack of explanation beforehand. I didn't get the results I initially agreed upon.
